blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Handyman Cost in Chelsea in 2026?
blogPosts.excerpt: Wondering about handyman rates in Chelsea? We break down typical costs for repairs, painting, carpentry and more in the Mornington Peninsula.
body: If you're searching for handyman services in Chelsea, one of the first questions is always about cost. Unlike big trades, handymen typically charge by the hour or offer fixed project quotes. In Chelsea, expect rates between $70 and $110 per hour for general repairs, depending on the complexity. For larger jobs like bathroom renovations or deck building, a project quote gives you certainty from the start.

At Hire A Hubby Chelsea, we provide free, no-obligation quotes for all jobs. Our standard call-out fee covers an on-site assessment, after which you'll receive a detailed fixed price. This means no surprises, even if the job takes longer than expected. We've found that Chelsea homeowners appreciate knowing the total cost upfront before any work begins.

Factors that affect handyman cost in Chelsea include the materials required, accessibility of the work area, and whether permits are needed. For example, structural carpentry or electrical work (which we subcontract to licensed electricians) may have higher rates. Coastal weather also means timber repairs and external painting may need more durable materials, slightly increasing costs.

Comparing quotes is always wise. But be cautious of extremely low rates – they often cut corners on insurance or materials. Our handymen are fully insured and carry public liability cover up to $20 million. We also offer a 100% workmanship guarantee, so if something isn't right, we'll fix it at no extra charge.

For small jobs like hanging shelves or repairing a fence, a half-day minimum often applies. This covers travel and setup. However, many Chelsea jobs can be bundled together to save money – for instance, while we're painting one room, we can also fix a squeaky door or replace a tap washer for a combined rate.

Ultimately, the best way to get an accurate handyman cost in Chelsea is to call us for a free quote. We'll discuss your needs, give you a realistic estimate, and schedule a visit at your convenience. Call 1800 803 339 or book online – we look forward to helping you.

blogPosts.title: Top 5 Bathroom Renovation Tips for Chelsea Homes
blogPosts.excerpt: Planning a bathroom renovation in Chelsea? Our local handymen share essential tips on tiling, waterproofing, and choosing coastal-friendly materials.
body: Bathroom renovations are one of the most popular services we perform in Chelsea homes. The coastal climate means moisture and salt air can accelerate wear, so choosing the right materials is crucial. Start by considering moisture-resistant paint and anti-slip tiles for safety. Our Chelsea handymen always recommend fully waterproofing the shower area to at least 1.8 metres height to prevent mould.

Budget is a key consideration. A mid-range Chelsea bathroom renovation typically costs between $15,000 and $25,000, depending on scope. At Hire A Hubby Chelsea, we offer fixed quotes and can help you prioritise upgrades – such as a new vanity, modern tapware, or a walk-in shower. Avoid the temptation to move plumbing unless necessary; it saves significant money.

Storage is often overlooked. In Chelsea's family homes, built-in shelving or a custom vanity with drawers can transform a cramped bathroom. Our carpentry team can design and install timber cabinetry that resists humidity. Use marine-grade plywood or waterproof MDF for long-lasting results.

Lighting makes a huge difference. Combine downlights with task lighting around the mirror. We install dimmable LED lights that work well in Chelsea's variable weather and are energy efficient. Also consider a ventilation fan that vents outside, not into the roof cavity, to prevent dampness.

Tiling should be both functional and stylish. Large-format tiles reduce grout lines and are easier to clean – ideal for busy households. Porcelain tiles are a great choice for Chelsea bathrooms because they handle moisture and temperature changes better than ceramic. Our tiling expertise ensures proper adhesive and grouting to avoid cracks.

Finally, don't forget the details: new towel rails, a heated towel rack, and quality caulking around edges. A good handyman will also check the waterproofing certification and ensure compliance with Australian Standards. Call us for a free bathroom assessment in Chelsea – we'll guide you through every step.

blogPosts.title: How to Prepare Your Chelsea Home for Sale – Handyman Tips
blogPosts.excerpt: Selling your Chelsea home? Our handyman guide covers painting, repairs, kerb appeal and staging to maximise your property value.
body: Preparing a home for sale in Chelsea can be a daunting task. Buyers notice everything – from chipped paint to sticky doors. A few strategic handyman repairs can significantly increase your sale price and speed up the sale. At Hire A Hubby Chelsea, we specialise in pre-sale makeovers that are quick and cost-effective.

Start with kerb appeal. Chelsea homes often feature front gardens and verandahs. Our team can pressure clean paths, repaint the front door, fix loose fence panels, and tidy up garden beds. First impressions matter, and a clean exterior invites buyers inside. We also recommend checking gutters and downpipes for blockages.

Inside, focus on fresh paint. Neutral tones like warm white or light grey appeal to the widest audience. We can paint walls, ceilings, and trim efficiently. Repair any holes in walls from picture hooks or furniture dings. Our handymen also fix squeaky floorboards, replace broken tiles, and ensure doors and windows open smoothly.

Kitchens and bathrooms are deal-makers. If your kitchen is dated, consider resurfacing cabinets rather than a full replacement. We can reface doors, replace handles, and install a new benchtop at a fraction of the cost. In bathrooms, regrouting, replacing silicone, and polishing taps can make a tired bathroom look fresh.

Don't overlook the small stuff. Replace light bulbs with warm LEDs, fix dripping taps, and ensure smoke alarms work. Our handymen can install new door handles, update switch plates, and even add a fresh coat of paint to the garage. These minor improvements add up to a 'move-in ready' impression.

Finally, staging advice: we can assemble furniture, hang mirrors, and arrange accessories to make rooms look larger. Our team has helped many Chelsea sellers achieve top dollar. Call us for a pre-sale quote – we'll walk through your home and recommend the most valuable improvements.
